figures.caption: Figure 1: Conceptual comparison between a schematic uniform regional aggregation baseline and HyBRA. The baseline assigns equal importance to channels within each region and may attenuate informative activity. HyBRA combines feature-dependent hyperbolic channel-to-region matching with a direct channel-evidence pathway to form fused region tokens. Waveforms are schematic.

Figure 2: Overview of HyBRA-EEG. Coordinate-aware channel patches enter parallel prior-constrained hyperbolic matching and channel-evidence injection paths. Their sum forms fixed region tokens, which are modeled by the Region-Time Transformer. Self-supervised pretraining predicts masked latent features and reconstructs region-level signals.
Table 1: Datasets used for pretraining and downstream finetuning. All signals are resampled to 200 Hz.

Table 2: Downstream results on six EEG datasets, reported as mean ± standard deviation. For TUAB and TUEV, task-specific baselines (Lawhern et al. 2018; Song et al. 2023; Jing et al. 2023; Yang et al. 2023; Peh, Yao, and Dauwels 2022; Li et al. 2022; Song et al. 2021) and EEG foundation models form separate comparison groups; for the remaining datasets, all EEG foundation models are compared together. Bold and underlined values denote the best and second-best results within each group.

Figure 3: Region attribution and token perturbation on OpenBMI-MI. (a) Subject-averaged normalized absolute Integrated Gradients (IG) attribution for each motor imagery class. (b) Subject-level BAcc after replacing the mostattributed, randomly selected, or least-attributed region tokens in each trial with the corresponding fold-specific training means. Shaded bands indicate bootstrap 95% confidence intervals across 54 subjects.

Table 5: Ablation BAcc on TUAB and TUEV, reported as mean ± standard deviation over five seeds. The Euclidean and cosine variants replace only the matching metric. The variant without brain-region tokenization applies the same axial Transformer and SSL objectives directly to channel-time tokens, while the variant without SSL pretraining trains HyBRA from random initialization. Bold values indicate the best result.

Figure 4: t-SNE visualization of downstream representations on BCIC-IV 2a. Each point denotes one EEG trial, and colors indicate motor-imagery classes. Each panel reports the Silhouette coefficient and Davies–Bouldin index computed on the displayed two-dimensional embedding.
